Package BankingInformationSystem

Class BankServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
BankingInformationSystem.BankServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
BankService
public class BankServiceImpl extends Object implements BankService

BankServiceImpl

This class provides the concrete implementation of the BankService interface. It contains the business logic for:
  • Account registration
  • User authentication (login)
  • Deposit, withdrawal, and transfer operations
  • Balance inquiry
  • Mini statement generation
Account data is stored in-memory using a HashMap where: 
     Key   → Account Number
     Value → Account Object
This implementation simulates a banking system without database persistence.

1.0
